completion_data.completion_summary: Landed the divisor-period search-coverage report's durable conclusions: a two-level regression pin of the WitnessRegistry.wrap() exact-period non-monotonicity (unit + integration), a new docs/SEARCH_COVERAGE.md comparing three routes and recommending a bounded sweep with a staged path, and an additive ADEQUACY.md section 7.1 pointer. The recommended sweep driver itself was deliberately not built, per the task's own scope.

memory_candidates.content: WitnessRegistry.wrap() folds position t by t % back (and symmetrically for fwd), so a back-period-p family is representable at a configured back=n iff p divides n. This makes a bimodal certificate search non-monotone in back/fwd: raising back from 4 to 5 does not enlarge coverage, since divisibility isn't monotone. Reproduce/measure such gaps by building a \prev-chain premise family and running the real Syntax->ModelConstraints->BimodalStructure pipeline across a small grid before writing any assertion, checking both z3_model_status and the timeout flag (UNKNOWN maps to status=False with timeout=True, so timeout must be asserted False to distinguish genuine UNSAT from an inconclusive solver run).

reflection.what_worked: Measuring the grid directly before writing any assertion (per the plan's Scope Hypothesis discipline) caught nothing to correct here, but it converted a report's prose claim into a verified, machine-checked fact rather than a transcription risk.
reflection.what_was_hard: Placing the ADEQUACY.md pointer required re-reading section 7.1 immediately before editing, since a concurrent sibling task had already restructured the flat condition (iii) into sub-bullets (iii-a) through (iii-e); the anchor had moved from what the plan's Scope Hypothesis assumed.
reflection.what_was_missed: Nothing from this task's own scope; the Phase 5 gate surfaced 4 pre-existing test failures in a file owned by a concurrent sibling task's in-flight edit, correctly identified as foreign rather than a regression.
reflection.successes: All five phases landed additively with zero production-code changes, full citation resolution, and no foreign-scope edits.

next_steps: Task complete. Follow-on work (the sweep driver, its opt-in setting, and its benchmark) is staged in docs/SEARCH_COVERAGE.md's Open Obligations list for a future task.
